verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents its own ways to move workload data off the platform. The CLI walkthrough includes a step to "copy data". SSH and direct Jupyter connections are documented for transferring and downloading files. The REST API (with a public OpenAPI spec) gives programmatic access to the whole platform. Volume data stays in ordinary files under the user's control. However, nothing documents a dedicated full-account export or a deliberate exit/portability path. missing for 10: documented account-wide data export (account, billing, template and instance metadata), explicit open-format export guarantees, account deletion/offboarding docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
